name: Benton County, WA
findings: Benton County has 570 nonprofit organizations. 279 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 221 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Benton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 19 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
